params.caption: 🎮 Call of Duty Valor Pack returns to help veterans find jobs The Call of Duty Endowment is marking Remembrance Day and its 17th anniversary by pushing its Valor Pack in Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone. Activision says all of its net proceeds from the pack go toward helping military veterans get jobs. 🕒 Nov 14, 2026 · 14:15 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @CallofDuty · @Activision ❤️ React if you'd grab it for a good cause · 💬 Have you bought a charity pack before? #CallOfDuty #ModernWarfare4 #Warzone #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
